post.title: $1,000 a month of passive income can take $300K. Or $3M
post.ig:
$1,000 a month in passive income can take $300,000.

Example: $12,000 a year / 4% yield = $300,000.
The S&P 500's dividend yield ended 2025 at 1.15%: that takes about $1.04 million. At the FDIC national average savings rate (under 0.4%), over $3 million.
The IRS usually treats rentals as passive even if you work on them, and side hustle profit owes 15.3% self-employment tax.

Sources: multpl/S&P; FDIC national rates; IRS Topics 425 and 554.
